info.heading: Create a complete carousel in a few steps
info.description: Add up to 24 content pieces, upload your visual identity and let the generator combine layouts, images and gradients with automatic contrast. Then select the title, copy, image or logo to adjust its position and size.
info.codeDescription: Code mode uses the ALFORA-CAROUSEL/1 format so you can prepare content with an AI, paste it into the tool, and quickly turn it into a visual carousel.
info.codeGuideDescription: ALFORA-CAROUSEL/1 is a simple text format. Each item is identified as c1, c2, c3, and so on up to c24. Each item can contain title, copy, additional copies such as copy2 and copy3, and imagen.
info.codeImageRule: For imagen you can write "auto" so Alfora automatically selects an uploaded image, "none" to create the slide without a background image, or specify an uploaded image number, for example "2".
info.aiHeading: You can also ask an AI for the code
info.aiDescription: An AI can create the full content and return it ready to paste. It only needs to follow ALFORA-CAROUSEL/1, use one line per field, and number items starting at c1.
info.aiPrompt: Example instruction for an AI: “Create a 6-image carousel about my product in ALFORA-CAROUSEL/1 format. For each image write cN.title, cN.copy, and cN.imagen in quotes. Use imagen: "auto" and do not add explanations outside the code.”
info.codeExample:
ALFORA-CAROUSEL/1
c1.title: "Turn ideas into content"
c1.copy: "Create a clear and attractive visual piece."
c1.copy2: "Add a second text block whenever you need it."
c1.imagen: "auto"

c2.title: "Design faster"
c2.copy: "Alfora organizes the content automatically."
c2.imagen: "2"
